analysis_plan.arithmetic: exact decimal context (prec 120, Inexact and Rounded trapped)
analysis_plan.ex_post_bound: per instrument, runs >= 1000 ms after the expiry where the bound winner would have paid against the displayed touch; reported separately, never used to select a trade
analysis_plan.post_expiry_activity: bbo changes with server time after the expiry; silence is not a halt
analysis_plan.post_record_book: the first l2Book for the instrument whose send time follows that record's receipt on the local monotonic clock; a winner gap is displayed if the winner YES ask < 1 or the loser YES bid > 0; after a record, tokens may be retired and post-settlement purchases, splits and redemption are unproven, so a displayed gap is a conditional display, never closed cash
analysis_plan.pre_record_gap: unavailable: no documented source timestamps the mark updates adjacent to the expiry
analysis_plan.record: the first settledOutcome response that binds to the requested id and the frozen spec with a fraction of exactly 0 or 1 (expiry-v1 binding)

decision_rules.candidate_post_record_display_conditiona: any instrument whose first causally later l2Book after its first bound record (fraction 0 or 1) displays a winner gap (winner YES ask < 1 or loser YES bid > 0); a conditional recorded post-settlement display only: tokens may already be retired and post-settlement purchases, splits and redemption are unproven, so it is never executable, closed cash or profit
decision_rules.inconclusive: otherwise, with reasons; failure states per instrument: no bound record, record only from the sweep, late or missing post-record book, unparsable book
decision_rules.never_decisive: pre-record gap (unavailable without timestamped adjacent marks), post-expiry bbo activity (silence is not a halt), ex-post runs (use the bound settlement; not knowable, not causal)
decision_rules.park_no_post_record_winner_gap_display: every instrument has a bound record from the event-driven follow-up and a causally later l2Book sent within 5 s of it that is null or displays no winner gap; scope: these check times only

draft_note: Collaborator draft (offline). The instruments are the 2026-10-03 06:00 UTC instances from the frozen snapshot, used for offline tests; expiry-v1 already covers that expiry, so a run needs root to pin a fresh outcomeMeta snapshot for a later expiry, list that day's ids, set status frozen_settle_window, add pins and a raw allocation. No request is authorized by this draft.
not_established: tradability, splitting or redemption after a settlement record

rest.follow_up: on the first outcomeSettled id of an instrument: settledOutcome, then l2Book for its YES coin sent only after the settledOutcome response is received (weights 20 and 2)
rest.meta_pre: outcomeMeta at open - 60 s via the frozen books-v1 fetch_all (weight 20)
rest.sweep: after the window, the same pair for each instrument without a valid bound record

retention.rule: stop reading the websocket at cap - reserve; queued follow-ups, the stop event and the sweep then fit; any stop other than window_closed censors the stream evidence

subscriptions: bbo for each instrument YES coin, ascending

window.launch: between open - 900 s and open - 120 s, else refused

storage_request_bytes.note: separate root allocation; no compression ratio assumed; a cap stop censors the stream evidence only
